title: Keep installed corpus manifest synchronized
scope: Restore the failing installed conformance input gate and provide one deterministic update path for every file hash pinned by the corpus manifest.
acceptance: A checked tool refreshes the manifest's GLB, lifecycle, quality, qualification and evidence-index hashes with the same cross-platform normalization used by the installed runner.
Focused tests prove stale input changes fail validation, refresh updates only the intended pins, and a second refresh is byte-identical.
The current sdk-ci suite and relocated installed-SDK input check pass from a clean revision.

history.reason: Manifest updater and relocated installed input gate pass from clean revision; standalone conformance package defect split for separate repair.
